001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.otlp;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.function.Consumer;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
017
018/**
019 * Encodes each event as one line of OTLP/JSON: a complete {@code LogsData} object holding
020 * a single log record. This is the OpenTelemetry file format, read by the OpenTelemetry
021 * Collector's {@code otlpjsonfile} receiver or by the {@code filelog} receiver with the
022 * {@code otlpjson} connector, so it needs no network connection.
023 * <p>
024 * Each record carries the formatted message as its body, the logger name as its
025 * instrumentation scope, {@code thread.name}, {@code thread.id}, every key value, and for
026 * a throwable {@code exception.type}, {@code exception.message}, and
027 * {@code exception.stacktrace} attributes. Event thread and exception attributes take
028 * precedence over context values with the same names. Key values named by
029 * {@code traceIdKey} and {@code spanIdKey} (default {@code traceId} and {@code spanId},
030 * as Micrometer Tracing puts them in the MDC) become the record's trace context when they
031 * are valid W3C ids.
032 */
033public final class OtlpJsonEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
034
035        /**
036         * Encoder URI scheme.
037         */
038        public static final String OTLP_SCHEME = "otlp";
039
040        /**
041         * Default key value name holding the trace id.
042         */
043        public static final String DEFAULT_TRACE_ID_KEY = "traceId";
044
045        /**
046         * Default key value name holding the span id.
047         */
048        public static final String DEFAULT_SPAN_ID_KEY = "spanId";
049
050        private final OtlpResource resource;
051
052        private final String traceIdKey;
053
054        private final String spanIdKey;
055
056        OtlpJsonEncoder(OtlpResource resource, String traceIdKey, String spanIdKey) {
057                this.resource = resource;
058                this.traceIdKey = traceIdKey;
059                this.spanIdKey = spanIdKey;
060        }
061
062        /**
063         * Creates the encoder with a builder lambda; properties are applied after the lambda.
064         * @param consumer configures the builder.
065         * @return encoder provider.
066         */
067        public static LogProvider<OtlpJsonEncoder> of(Consumer<OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
068                return (s, c) -> {
069                        var b = new OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder(s);
070                        consumer.accept(b);
071                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
072                };
073        }
074
075        /**
076         * Creates the encoder.
077         * @param name property name prefix.
078         * @param serviceName {@code service.name} resource attribute, default
079         * {@code unknown_service:java}.
080         * @param resourceAttributes additional resource attributes.
081         * @param traceIdKey key value holding the trace id, default {@code traceId}.
082         * @param spanIdKey key value holding the span id, default {@code spanId}.
083         * @param environmentVariables whether {@code OTEL_SERVICE_NAME} and
084         * {@code OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES} are read, default off.
085         * @return encoder.
086         */
087        @LogConfigurable(name = "OtlpJsonEncoderBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX + "otlp.")
088        static OtlpJsonEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable String serviceName,
089                        @Nullable Map<String, String> resourceAttributes, @Nullable String traceIdKey, @Nullable String spanIdKey,
090                        @ConvertParameter("parseEnvironmentVariables") @Nullable EnvironmentVariables environmentVariables) {
091                var env = environmentVariables == null ? EnvironmentVariables.OFF : environmentVariables;
092                return new OtlpJsonEncoder(OtlpResource.of(serviceName, resourceAttributes, env),
093                                traceIdKey == null ? DEFAULT_TRACE_ID_KEY : traceIdKey,
094                                spanIdKey == null ? DEFAULT_SPAN_ID_KEY : spanIdKey);
095        }
096
097        static EnvironmentVariables parseEnvironmentVariables(String value) {
098                return EnvironmentVariables.parse(value);
099        }
100
101        @Override
102        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
103                return new JsonBuffer(false, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, -1);
104        }
105
106        @Override
107        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
108                buffer.clear();
109                OtlpJson.write(buffer, resource, List.of(OtlpRecord.of(event, traceIdKey, spanIdKey)));
110                buffer.writeLineFeed();
111        }
112
113}
